title: Dasher Analytics Event Schema v1
description: CANONICAL copy (governance) — RFC 0022 item 6. Frontend copies are generated: each frontend's schema-sync workflow pulls this file and opens a PR when it changes. Edit HERE, never in a frontend repo. Published openly at https://github.com/dasher-project/Dasher-Windows. If it's not in this schema, it's not collected. All Dasher frontends (Windows, Apple, GTK) share the same PostHog project — events are distinguished by the default properties below.

default_properties.description: Automatically appended to every event from every frontend

$geoip_disable.description: Sent on every event (including crashes): PostHog Cloud must not derive location from the client IP (RFC 0001: no location data).

analytics_id_reset.description: User reset their anonymous analytics ID

stack_trace.note: May contain file paths but not user text

ime_mode_restore.description: The IME decided which mode (docked/floating) to open in — every input-view creation. Android only. Decision inputs for the dock/float lifecycle debugging (Dasher-Android #73/#75).

always_docked.description: The Settings → Input escape hatch is enabled

floating_before.description: Stale floating state present BEFORE self-healing (true = the #73 path)

restored_floating.description: The decision: the keyboard opened floating

ime_float_enter.description: The IME entered floating mode. Android only.

reason.description: button = explicit user tap; restore = saved-preference restore on keyboard show

ime_float_exit.description: The IME left floating mode. Android only.

persist.description: false = system-driven cleanup, the saved preference is unchanged

reason.description: button = user tapped Dock; selfheal = stale-state cleanup at show; unbind = input binding went away (IME switch); destroy = the IME service was destroyed while floating

ime_always_docked_changed.description: User toggled Settings → Input → 'Keyboard always starts docked'. Android only. Adoption of this escape hatch is the signal for whether last-mode restore is the right default.

ui_action.description: User activated a control in the main UI (outside settings windows) — RFC 0001 2026-10-28 amendment. Answers 'where should main-UI focus go'.

action.description: Fixed vocabulary; new identifiers require a schema update

state.description: Optional — toggle states, or the delete kind for the backspace action

setting_changed.description: User committed a settings change — RFC 0001 2026-10-28 amendment. Answers 'which settings are the priority'. Fires at the widget commit site only (never for programmatic engine changes).

setting_id.description: Canonical identifier: DasherCore parameter name or frontend setting key

value.description: Present ONLY for bool/number/enum (fixed vocabularies). NEVER for string settings — free text is not collected

settings_reset_defaults.description: User reset every engine parameter to its built-in default

training_reset.description: User deleted their accumulated training data via the Preferences training row

engine_error.description: DasherCore raised its sticky error flag (RFC 0009 A2). Non-fatal: reported once per session and the app keeps running.

stack_trace.note: Fixed marker string identifying the flag, not a captured stack

engine_error.note: Shares the PostHog `$exception` channel with `crash`; the two are distinguished by exception_type.

explicitly_not_collected: User name, email, or account info
